mapper.select: select id, region_id, gift_name, gold_amount, receive_limit, coalesce(nullif(status, ''), '0') as status, create_time from external_gift_pack and coalesce(nullif(status, ''), '0') = #{status}and region_id = #{regionId} order by id desc
select id, region_id, gift_name, gold_amount, receive_limit, coalesce(nullif(status, ''), '0') as status, create_time from external_gift_pack where id = #{id}
select id, gift_id, item_type, prop_id, vip_level, day_num, quantity, sort_no from external_gift_pack_item where gift_id = #{giftId} order by sort_no, id
select id, gift_id, item_type, prop_id, vip_level, day_num, quantity, sort_no from external_gift_pack_item where gift_id in #{giftId} order by gift_id, sort_no, id

select q.account_id, a.login_name, q.gift_id, g.gift_name, q.quota_count, q.used_count from external_gift_pack_quota q join external_manager_account a on a.id=q.account_id join external_gift_pack g on g.id=q.gift_id where q.account_id=#{accountId} order by q.account_id,g.id
mapper.insert: insert into external_gift_pack_quota(account_id,gift_id,quota_count,used_count) values(#{accountId},#{giftId},#{quotaCount},0) on duplicate key update quota_count=#{quotaCount}
mapper.update: update external_gift_pack_quota set used_count=used_count+1 where account_id=#{accountId} and gift_id=#{giftId} and used_count < quota_count
mapper.select: select count(1) from external_gift_pack_issue where gift_id=#{giftId} and receiver_uid=#{receiverUid} and status='0'

select i.id,g.gift_name,i.receiver_uid,u.chat_no as receiver_chat_no,a.login_name,i.content_snapshot,i.status,i.create_time from external_gift_pack_issue i join external_gift_pack g on g.id=i.gift_id join external_manager_account a on a.id=i.account_id left join `user` u on u.uid=i.receiver_uid where i.account_id=#{accountId} order by i.id desc
